$comment: Region record (docs/DESIGN.md#regions-and-feeds). The id remains central-okanagan for existing data URLs; coverage now includes South Okanagan-Similkameen, Kelowna, North Okanagan and Shuswap. Areas keep region selection separate from Merritt, Kamloops and Kootenays. initialBounds remains the first view of /transit (the 97, West Kelowna to UBC Okanagan).
name: Okanagan
$feeds: The primary feed (stable id bc-transit-kelowna) merges the Okanagan and Shuswap systems so their transfers show together (config/feeds/bc-transit-kelowna/feed.json).
$timezoneChecks: Known facts about this region's time zone that the runtime's time zone data (tzdata, via ICU) must agree with; the server refuses to start otherwise (checkTimezoneData in packages/transit-core/src/time.ts). Times are still always computed from the runtime's data, never from these. BC moved to permanent UTC-7 in 2026 (tzdata 2026b, https://data.iana.org/time-zones/tzdb/NEWS); older data falls back to UTC-8 on 2026-11-01.

timezoneChecks.reason: British Columbia's permanent UTC-7 (tzdata 2026b or later)
